recipe_yield.demand: the fabric recipe wants every redundant lane independently labelled with its own qualifier (x-connect on 4 MUX->core lanes, active/standby on 8 FW lanes, ECMP on 8 fabric lanes, dual on 4 rack lanes).
measured_attempts: v1-a1 (4 x-connect labels): labels 4/4 placed, 2 ambiguous owners - recorded.
v1-a2 (label_slot lever): still 2 ambiguous owners - recorded.
v1-a3-spare-rank (extra rank slot for corridor height): still 2 ambiguous owners - recorded.
probe-cross-isolated (bare 4-node K2,2, same 4 labels): 3/4 placed with 1 SKIPPED plus 2 ambiguous owners - proves the limit is not view density - recorded.
v2-a1 (8 active/standby labels): 2 ambiguous owners - recorded.
v2-a3-lr (same labels, lr): 4 ambiguous owners - recorded.
probe-fabric-ab (8 ECMP labels) and probe-fabric-ab-labelslot: 2 ambiguous owners each - recorded.
probe-racks (4 dual labels): 1 ambiguous owner - recorded.
probe-racks-2split (2 dual labels, one per leaf): 1 ambiguous owner - recorded.
calibration probe-racks-1label and probe-racks-2same-fan: 0 ambiguous owners when the labels belong to one source fan.
recipe_yield.verdict: The round-10 router places a label only when another route is strictly farther from the text than its own route. In a full K2,2 cross every route keeps a 1-cell neighbour, so three or more duplicate qualifier labels on the four lanes cannot all be unambiguous; one label, or the two labels of a single source fan, place cleanly (measured above).
recipe_yield.closest_honest_result: each view prints the tier qualifier on one fan (1-2 labels, 0 ambiguous owners) and the qualifier's scope is stated here; all 28 links are drawn regardless of which lane carries the text. Nothing is deleted or reversed to earn the clean check.

abbreviations: Device identities are the source's own short forms: ISP A-D, MUX 1-2, Core 1-2, FW1 active, FW2 standby, BL 1-2, Spine 1-2, Leaf 1-2, Rack 1-2 (no invented names).
Per-link active/standby on the 6 unlabelled firewall links is carried by the appliance text FW1 active / FW2 standby (line 126 states the pair is active-passive).
x-connect, ECMP and dual are uniform tier qualifiers; each is printed on one fan of its tier instead of on every lane (recipe_yield above).
deliberate_drops: none - all 18 nodes and all 28 links appear; no qualifier is omitted, only relocated to the appliance text or printed once per tier.
known_defects: v3 keeps 6 bridges: the BL->spine cross-connects are back edges into a rank that also feeds the leaves, so congestion is structural. Reordering the tiers or splitting the pair is forbidden by line 248 and by the recipe, so the count is kept and reported.
v2 keeps 2 bridges (the two K2,2 crosses), v1 and v4 keep 1 each (a K2,2 needs one crossing in a two-layer drawing).
The tier qualifier text appears on one fan per tier, not on every lane (measured engine limit, see recipe_yield).
